reason: Twenty-two thousand is more than a month and a half of everything we earn, and then six and a half more for the panel because our grid hardly gives power to charge it. Hand-washing costs us nothing, so I cannot put that much money into a machine.
objection: Even ₹1,999 a month for a whole year is too heavy for us, and I don't know if this battery will really last in our village or if the dealer will come when it breaks. Nobody I know has one yet.
would_change_my_mind: If a relative or neighbour had used it for a season and the dealer offered it for much less, with the solar panel included and a smaller monthly amount.
